title: Hand the raw pointer to unique_ptr
summary: Drop new and delete, return ownership, then std::move it where it is handed off.

turns.user: pretty sure make_session leaks on some path. can we just use unique_ptr

assistant.body: Let's return the ownership instead. If make_session hands back a std::unique_ptr, the delete in run goes away and RAII guarantees the release.

turns.user: forgot to mention, right after that we do pool.hold(s). now it says it cannot copy

assistant.body: Note: unique_ptr has no copy. Handing it over gives up ownership, so the call needs std::move. In summary, there is always exactly one owner.
